sms.title: SMS commands
sms.description: What to send by SMS to which truck. Send a text from your phone to the truck's SIM number; the unit answers to the phone that sent it.
sms.syntax: Every text has the form command#password[#parameters].
sms.caseInsensitive: Commands and the password are case-insensitive.
sms.maxBytes: A text to the unit may be at most 64 bytes; the unit does not accept a longer one.
sms.replyTo: The unit sends its reply to the phone number that sent the command.
sms.noPasswordHint: No Simple SMS password is stored for this device, so its texts cannot be prepared. Add the password (parameter 0593) in the device editor.
sms.copyByHand: The browser did not allow copying. The text is selected: press Ctrl+C, or tap Copy on a phone.
sms.tooLong: {bytes} bytes: longer than 64 bytes, so the unit does not accept it.
sms.karmaWarning: Emergency only. After these texts the unit reports to Karma, and DiscoCan receives none of its data until you route it back to DiscoCan.

check.title: Check the unit
check.description: These texts only read; they change nothing on the unit. Use them to see whether the unit answers and which server it reports to.

route.title: Route to DiscoCan
route.description: Makes DiscoCan (65.108.137.165, port 11500) the unit's primary server. Send the two texts in this order and send the second one only after the reply ok#setparam to the first. About 10 minutes later check the result with getparam 49 and 50. If the unit does not come online, call its SIM number to wake it.

karma.title: Emergency: back to Karma
karma.description: Makes Karma (in.karma.online, port 500) the unit's primary server again. Send the two texts in this order and send the second one only after the reply ok#setparam to the first.

info.when: To see that the unit is alive and answers SMS, and to read its model, serial number, firmware, GSM operator and signal, IP address and voltages.
info.reply: One line such as StarLink-CT 2e1-XL #02A23F 2.34; 05/11 06:22; "ORANGE" (425001) …; the fields depend on the firmware.

loc.when: To see where the truck is when it is not online. The unit answers with its last known position and does not switch GNSS on for it.
loc.reply: Event: Location; In: …; Out: …; LocTime: …; Speed: …; Link: http://maps.google.com/?q=…

getparam49.when: To see which server the unit sends its data to.
getparam49.reply: 65.108.137.165 when the unit is routed to DiscoCan; in.karma.online when it reports to Karma.

getparam50.reply: 11500 when the unit is routed to DiscoCan; 500 when it reports to Karma.

getparam51.when: To check the backup server that the unit uses when its primary server does not answer.

getparam52.reply: 500, the port of the Karma backup server.

route49.purpose: Step 1: DiscoCan's address as the primary server
route49.when: The first text when you route the unit to DiscoCan.

route50.when: Send it after the reply to step 1.
route50.reply: ok#setparam. The unit then connects to DiscoCan.

karma49.purpose: Step 1: Karma's address as the primary server

karma50.when: Send it after the reply to step 1.
karma50.reply: ok#setparam. The unit then reports to Karma again.

settings.title: Device settings
settings.hint: One controlled change per unit. A write first reads the parameters again, reads the baseline, writes and reads back. A mismatch restores the exact baseline. An uncertain submission is never replayed.
settings.primaryRequired: A primary connection to DiscoCan is required.
settings.writesDisabled: Configuration writes are disabled by the server. Read-only eData inspection is available.
settings.globalsHint: Complete 49-byte value. Readback must match every byte.
settings.confirm: {operation} for {target}. The workflow records every step and the result.
settings.uncertain: The request could not be confirmed. Refresh the run history before submitting again.
settings.batchHint: Devices run in selection order. The batch stops at the first result other than Verified. Select at most 100 Devices; each needs a primary connection and enabled writes.
settings.batchStopped: Batch stopping: the active device will finish.
settings.batchConfirm: {operation} on {count} Devices, one at a time.
settings.readRoleRequired: Operator or Administrator access is required for device reads. Engineers also have access.
settings.writeRoleRequired: Engineer or Administrator access is required.
settings.baselineUnavailable: The saved parameter values could not be loaded.

console.title: Command console
console.hint: Choose a command, pick the parameter from the catalog and check the exact command before sending. Changes run through the guarded workflow: baseline read, write, exact readback and optional restore.

kinds.EDATA_INTERVAL: eData parameter: add, interval, remove from use

console.parameterHint: Search by number, name or category.
console.profileUnknown: Read the eData configuration to detect the unit's profile.
console.catalogMissing: The eData catalog is not imported; names are unavailable.
console.intervalCurrent: Configured: {interval} s. 0 removes it from use.
console.intervalNew: Not configured on the unit; it will be added.
console.restoreAfter: Restore the previous value after verification
console.previewNote: The device server adds the reference ‹ref›, the frame and the checksum when it sends. The bold line changes the unit.
console.previewEmpty: Complete the fields to see the command.
console.confirmMessage: {operation} on {target}. These commands will be sent in order:
console.confirmWrite: This changes the unit's configuration. The change stays after verification; a readback mismatch restores the baseline.
console.confirmRestore: This changes the unit's configuration and restores the previous value after verification.
console.snapshotStarted: Parameter read started. Values appear in the Parameters tab when it completes.
console.readStale: The configuration changed after this read. Read it again before the next change.
console.noDefinitions: The unit reported no parameter definitions.
console.noRead: No eData configuration read yet. Send “Read eData configuration”.

stepLabels.snapshot: Read 20 parameters at a time (45), for every catalog parameter except 0049–0054

console.engineerRequired: Changes and the full parameter read require the Engineer role.
console.writesDisabled: Configuration writes are disabled on this deployment.
console.primaryRequired: The unit must be connected to DiscoCan as primary.
console.running: Another configuration operation is running on this unit.
console.notWritable: This parameter cannot be changed from the console (routing, lock or secret).
console.intervalRange: Use a whole number from 0 to 65000.
console.intervalAdd: Use an interval above 0 to add a parameter.
console.uncertain: The result is uncertain. Check the history before sending again.
console.readParametersHint: Up to 20; routing, lock and secret parameters are excluded. The read waits in the queue until the unit connects.

latestRouteWrite: Latest Karma write to the route

routing.title: Routing
routing.returnConfirm: Request {unit} to return from Karma backup to DiscoCan. The unit must be parked. This requires Engineer or Administrator access; acceptance does not confirm the return.
routing.returnPending: A return is pending. Wait for its outcome; an uncertain request must not be repeated.
routing.returnNotParked: Return is available only while the unit is parked.
routing.returnParkingUnknown: Return is unavailable until parking is confirmed.
routing.returnBackupRequired: Return requires a unit on Karma backup.
routing.returnUnconfirmed: Refresh the routing status before trying again; the request may have been accepted.
routing.returnEngineer: Engineer or Administrator access is required to return a unit to DiscoCan.
routing.returnConflict: The unit must still be parked on Karma backup with no pending return. Refresh its status.
routing.returnUnavailable: The Karma return service is unavailable. Refresh the status before another attempt.
routing.returnSession: Sign in again before requesting a return.

recoveryStates.ALREADY_DISCOCAN: Primary already points to DiscoCan; nothing written
